headline: As of 2026-10-16: 7,862,225 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 7,862,225 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,048,227), Florida (814,139), Georgia (681,852).
